thetadata_v3.finding: ThetaData stock symbol list includes dead names (ATVI, TWTR, CERN, XLNX confirmed enumerable via /v3/stock/list/symbols). Historical EOD data is behind a paid stock subscription; the current account has FREE stock access. STANDARD subscription required for recent data; PROFESSIONAL required for history back to 2012-06. The options PROFESSIONAL subscription does NOT grant stock history.
thetadata_v3.verdict: NOT USABLE — requires separate stock subscription upgrade (~$120+/mo for Standard, more for Professional)

flat_files_s3.note_no_adjusted: Flat files are UNADJUSTED. REST adjusted=true endpoint is preferred for dead-name price recovery (accounts for splits/dividends before delisting).

polygon_rest.verdict: PRIMARY SOURCE for post-2021-07-06 dead names. 418 names covered. REST adjusted aggregates preferred over S3 flat files (flat files unadjusted; REST handles split/div adjustment).

stooq.from_mac_ip: BLOCKED — all .us symbol queries return 'page does not exist' (HTML 404 wrapper). This is the IP-level block documented in collectors/edgar_deadname_prices.py.
stooq.from_ci_ip: UNCERTAIN — edgar_deadname_prices.py comment says 'HTML-blocks some IPs, reachable from CI'. Not verified in this probe session.
stooq.coverage_if_accessible: Deep history for acquisitions; shallow for bankruptcies. Free, no key required. Quality: unadjusted close prices.
stooq.note_adjusted: Stooq provides unadjusted prices. For names with splits before delisting (less common for delisters), this creates a bias. Acceptable for sector-relative return computation at scale.
stooq.verdict: CANDIDATE for pre-2021 era if CI IP is unblocked. Not confirmable from this probe. The existing edgar_deadname_prices.py collector already implements Stooq as primary source; it just needs to run from CI.

yfinance.verdict: NOT USABLE — documented ~0% coverage for delisted names. edgar_deadname_prices.py uses as last-resort fallback only.
